newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: S.Africa seeks help in gold processing - Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa seeks help in gold processing - Malaysia.

text.p: South Africa is seeking Malaysia's help in the jewellery industry as it did not have the expertise for commercial processing of gold and precious stones, Malaysian International Trade and Industry Minister Rafidah Aziz said on Sunday.

"I was told South Africa has abundant raw materials but they did not have value-added industries...if gold is sold, it is sold as gold bars, similarly diamond is sold without polishing," the national Bernama news agency quoted her as saying.

Rafidah said the request was conveyed to her by South Africa's deputy trade and industry minister, P. Mlambo-Ngcuka, when they met recently. South African President Nelson Mandela is currently visiting Malaysia with a political and business delegation.

Rafidah told reporters after an official function that she had established the links between Malaysians involved in gold production and designing, with representatives of the trade delegation accompanying Mandela, who is on a five-day official visit to Malaysia.
"We have a big jewellery industry but lack of raw materials while South Africa has abundance of such materials," she was quoted as saying.
Malaysia currently fabricates about 90 tonnes of gold annually for jewellery.
